caseName: Southern Pacific Co. v. Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: Southern Pacific Co. v. Public Utilities Commission of California
attorneys: George L. Buland, Evan J. Foulds, James E. Lyons, Robert L. Pierce and Charles W. Burkett, Jr. for appellant. Everett C. McKeage for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of California.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
